Imagine if you will, a classic game.

A game well liked by men and women, by young and old.

A game that has characters of a wide variety and lets you play with them as you see fit.

A game where you have a real choice on how to play through the game, be it chaotic, evil, good, lawful, a little bit of each... You can often make as many as 3 different choices in how to tackle a mission. You can save people, rob people, make men into women, men into chickens... Whatever you want.

You get to become a hero or villain, one whose actions change the region you live in.

Now imagine a developer fixes it up, polishes it off and sells it to a new generation of gamers. It is loved again.

Now that developer says they are making an expansion, that the sales for the rerelease were good enough that the rights holder has allowed them to delve into the lore and make new stories and characters that the player can encounter with their already existing character and party. They brag about how they have gotten really deep into the old and forgotten elements of this Dungeons and Dragons universe.

Now, imagine the press junket starts. Developers go to various websites and magazines to promote this expansion that needs no promotion, only to be named and sold.

And the junket includes segments where the writer speaks poorly of the original game, decrying it as racist, sexist, problematic...

The expansion goes on sale. And it is riddled with memes. The writer who spoke ill of a classic of gaming has put a bunch of pop-references in that date the game and it seems lazy.

Then you encounter a mob attacking a woman, and a child stops you from interfering. "My mom can take care of herself." Well, that is not very roleplay-ish. I should be able to killer her, save her, save her only to kill her... I should have options. Oh well.

Then you encounter a man who claims he is really a woman. This while you are a woman who has the body of a man because of a cursed ring you are currently wearing. It feels out of place and silly. They should just have a ring like this.

Then you hit a bug that wipes out all your items. Well shit.
